mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering blood and then recovering useful substances made it clear that the kidney does more than simply remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Checking the recovered fluid, connected body and recovery tube without finding a partner felt repetitive and left me unsure how to proceed.

surprise.text: I was surprised that useful glucose and water pass through the filter along with waste and must be taken back.

arbitrary.text: The final pairing was hard to discover: inspecting the recovered fluid showed no partners, but later inspecting the assembled kidney pair found it. The route itself made sense once shown.

continue.text: I might continue because following the filter and recovery route was interesting, but I would hope the next chapter makes its remaining connections easier to discover.
